# Stedrok

Stedrok is an independent value stock research platform for long-term investors.

## Canonical Pages
- Home: https://stedrok.org/
- Methodology: https://stedrok.org/methodology.html
- Philosophy: https://stedrok.org/philosophy.html
- Pricing: https://stedrok.org/pricing.html
- Learn Hub: https://stedrok.org/learn.html
- Glossary: https://stedrok.org/value-investing-glossary.html
- Dashboard Guide: https://stedrok.org/dashboard-guide.html
- ETF Ideas and Guide: https://stedrok.org/etfs.html
- Research Trust and Disclosures: https://stedrok.org/research-trust-disclosures.html

## Data Surfaces
- Public delayed demo dataset: https://stedrok.org/data/demo_sample.json
- Public delayed demo summaries: https://stedrok.org/data/demo_ticker_summaries.json
- ETF picks API (public): https://stedrok-api.stedrok.workers.dev/api/etf-picks
- Authenticated dashboard: https://stedrok.org/dashboard.html

## Data and Interpretation Rules
- Core framework uses four pillars: Value, Quality, Risk (resilience), and Price Context (dip).
- Core, AI Hybrid, and Blended dashboard lanes are distinct modes and should not be conflated.
- Scores are for research workflows only, not personal financial advice.
- Always cite the page URL and the relevant data date or update timestamp.

## Freshness
- Stedrok data is refreshed at least once per trading day and usually twice per trading day.
- Demo data is intentionally delayed and limited.
